$comment: Configuration for packages/adr/adr-audit.ts (the ADR Embodiment audit). Checked into git so tolerance/scan policy is reviewable and versioned like everything else, not a hardcoded constant only visible by reading the tool's source. Every key here is optional -- omit to take the tool's built-in default.
publishedPathsReason: packages/contracts is publicly mirrored -- internal governance/decision references (ADR comments, revNNN aside) don't belong in published source at all.
publishedPathViolationsBlockReason: Blocking because these files publish beyond this repo: a decision reference in them is a pointer their readers cannot resolve, which is not a warn-only concern. Note this fails until the separate citation-cleanup branch lands on main -- main still carries 25 such references -- so this PR merges after that one.
